origin.description: Cramer-von Mises test of the composite hypothesis of normality.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector with more than 7 non-missing values. Missing values are dropped.

origin.details: W is 1/(12n) plus the sum of squared differences between the normal cdf of the standardized order statistics and (2i-1)/(2n). The p-value uses Stephens' table on W times (1 + 0.5/n). When that adjusted value is at least 1.1, the p-value is 7.37e-10 and a warning says it cannot be computed more accurately.
origin.value: An htest list with statistic W, the p-value, the method, and the data name.

translation.description: Cramer-von Mises test of the composite hypothesis of normality.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric values with more than 7 non-missing entries. NaN is dropped.

translation.details: W is 1/(12n) plus the sum of squared differences between the normal cdf of the standardized order statistics and (2i-1)/(2n). The p-value uses Stephens' table on W times (1 + 0.5/n). When that adjusted value is at least 1.1, the p-value is 7.37e-10 and a warning says it cannot be computed more accurately. The cdf is math.erf.
translation.value: An htest object with statistic W, the p-value, the method, and the data name.
translation.example:
from nortest import cvm_test

x = [2.1, 3.4, float("nan"), 1.2, 5.6, 4.0, 3.3, 2.8, 6.1, 1.9, float("nan"), 4.4]
print(cvm_test(x), end="")
